name: Swap stalls on Two clusters
lesson: With swap mutation the search often settles just above the optimum on Two clusters, and a stagnation stop ends the run there.
lookFor: With this seed the best tour, 0.25 % over the optimum, is found at generation 26, nothing improves for 100 generations, and Run until stop pauses at generation 126 (the stagnation window is 100). Over seeds 1 to 30 with these settings 16 runs reach the optimum and 14 stop above it, between 0.25 % and 1.02 % over; with inversion instead of swap 28 of the 30 reach it.
